# Google Cloud Inventory & Change Audit

**Template revision:** v2.0.1 · 2026-10-30

**Full setup guide:** [Read the complete documentation](https://paoloronco.notion.site/Google-Cloud-Inventory-Change-Audit-408f0ba27c3281aea226fecadfab05f8?pvs=73)

**Support & customization:** [info@paoloronco.it](mailto:info@paoloronco.it) · [paoloronco.it](https://paoloronco.it).

### How it works
For cloud operations teams: run manually or daily at 03:15 in the workflow timezone. Discover resources and visible IAM policies through Cloud Asset Inventory, assess governance rules, and compare completed BigQuery snapshots. The first scan establishes a baseline. Google Sheets provides five review tabs, four charts, filters and checkboxes; HTML/CSV exports and conditional email digests complete delivery. The n8n data table tracks scan and delivery status. Coverage depends on API visibility; this is not a complete security or compliance audit.

### Setup
1. [Open Google Sheets dashboard/model](https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/16uTQRgZSTN2GN2nE2giTPu2ZyfWONfvt5m5gkOIOgeY/copy). Create your own copy and share it as Editor with your Sheets service account.
2. Enable Cloud Asset Inventory, BigQuery and Sheets APIs. Connect Google API credentials to all HTTP nodes: inventory/IAM read access, BigQuery jobs and dataset/table write access, plus Sheets edit access.
3. In Configuration, set scope, billingProject, dataset, location, sheetId, emailTo and emailFrom; review limits and governance rules. Connect SMTP to Email digest. Review the execution URL in Initialize run.
4. Select your Error Workflow in Settings. Check timezone, run manually, verify Sheets/BigQuery/reports and a second scan, then publish to enable scheduling. BigQuery storage and queries may incur charges.

### Customization
Adjust requiredLabels, labelAssetTypes, allowedLocations, retention, reportChangeLimit and notifyEveryRun. Keep sheet headers and hidden identifiers intact.

## 01 · Configure and track runs

Validate scope, destinations and resource limits before discovery. The data table records RUNNING, COMPLETE or FAILED independently from delivery status. Configure credentials and destinations before the first run.

## 02 · Discover and assess

Paginated resource and IAM searches feed canonical inventory and governance checks. Review public access, broad roles, labels and locations. Unavailable IAM coverage is reported explicitly; zero findings does not establish security.

## 03 · Persist and compare snapshots

Batched BigQuery jobs wait for completion and validate errors. Only complete snapshots become baselines. The first scan establishes a baseline; later scans identify added, modified and removed assets. Set retention and billed-byte limits for your environment.

## 04 · Review and deliver results

Update the dashboard, inventory, findings, changes and scan history. Preserve review checkboxes and notes by stable identifiers. Conditional email digests summarize actionable changes. Keep headers and hidden IDs intact; download HTML and CSV from Report files.

## 05 · Record failures

Persist failure details and stop the execution so n8n can invoke the Error Workflow selected in Settings. Automatic runs use the native error handler; inspect manual failures in Executions. No duplicate error email is sent here.
